source_issues_already_corrected_by_autho: Huang's reciprocal-log displayed energy kernel is replaced by the correct logarithmic kernel.
Informal open-domain capacity and approximation notation is replaced by compact closed sets.
Historical priority is credited to Pommerenke; Huang v2 is identified as a later rediscovery.
audit_precision_notes: Erdos 1961 printed page 246 uses the closed inequality; OCR can misread it as strict.
Author finite controls are checks of examples, not universal proof certificates.
The reconstruction does not establish the stronger all-sufficiently-large-prescribed-degrees version or asymptotic follow-ons.
The original Pommerenke proof remains uninspected; no claim otherwise is authorized.
